title: 第十三章 A级团队任务
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
“掌柜的！这把剑……”林铮刚想说，“我买了！”倒是胖掌柜先开口了，他乐呵着脸道：“客人要是觉得这剑贵了，其实也是可以商量地！”
“哦？”林铮双眉一挑，能便宜点谁愿意被宰啊！“怎么说？能打几折？”
“呵呵！不是打折的问题！”胖掌柜笑道，“我这边有件事情，由于抽不开身去做，让我最近烦的要死,客人您要是帮我解决了，这把剑就送给你了，另外本人还有重礼酬谢！”
“擦！不嘞个是吧！这就把隐藏任务触发了啊！”旁边的玩家懊恼地叫道。
林铮瞥了一眼，没有理会这帮蛋疼的家伙,说道：“不知道有什么可以帮到你的？”
“是这样子的！”胖掌柜道，“我那捣蛋的孩子把药剂师公会里的丹炉弄坏了，出于责任，我必须找到材料来修复那个丹炉，现在我需要找到一种耐热的金属矿物，听说霜晶洞里面有个怪物的体内就能生成这种矿物，你去帮我弄到这种矿物吧！”
“您已接受任务‘极寒的考验’，任务等级A级中等，前往天霜城北方的霜晶洞,杀死霜晶洞最底层的boss拿到boss的核，霜晶洞是一处危险的地方,在你前往之前最好寻找一些同伴，最高任务共享人数5人！”
A级的团队任务啊！经验和奖励应该很不错！当然，相应的，难度也会很大！而且，人员的挑选也是一个很大的问题！首先杨琪能算一个，那么还有三个找谁？奶妈那是必备的，但林铮认识的奶妈只有小喵一个，而且还是个九点半立刻睡觉的好孩子，太不靠谱了！算了，先联系一下杨琪，看看有没有什么好介绍。
“什么事小林子，姐正忙着呢，有话快说！”杨琪的声音传进了林铮耳中，旁边还有怪兽咆哮着，显然杨琪正忙着杀怪升级。林铮也不废话，开口便道：“接了个团队任务，要5个人呢，算你一个了！”
“团队任务啊！什么等级的？”杨琪很感兴趣的问道。
“A级中等的，油水一定充足！”
“靠！这么牛的任务，等等我！我马上来！”
“呃！也不急，有点晚了，我们下去吃个饭再上来做吧！”
“倒也是！7点了都！”
“我先下去烧水，泡好面叫你！”
“去吧！去吧！”
从游戏仓中爬起来，林铮立刻就去烧了水。现在用的都是新能源，加热技术也提高了不少，这烧个水也就两三分钟的事情。前后不到十分钟，两大碗面便泡好了。叫上杨琪，两人三两下将面搞定了，便又匆匆进入游戏了。按杨琪说的，A级中等的任务可不是三两下就能完成，得抓紧时间！
上了游戏，林铮出现在了装备店门口，马上亮了，一想任务要5个人，除了得找个靠谱点的奶妈，另外两个，便宜谁不如给自己的妹子！于是林铮向二人发出了组队邀请。
系统提示：“玩家长孙有希进入队伍！玩家萌妹守护者进入队伍！”
“都来城门口集合，准备做任务了！”林铮在队伍频道喊道。

“什么任务啊神棍哥哥！？”小萌问道。
“过来你就知道了！”“滴！”一条信息，来自杨琪的私聊，林铮一接通，杨琪马上叫道：“又是两个妹子，好小子，一天下来你就认识四个妹子了，你到底是玩游戏还是泡妹子啊，姐姐我伤心了！”
“一边去！”林铮没好气地说道，“我和你说啊！等下见到人家，你给我老实点，尤其是有希，你要是有什么不检点的，我真担心你会不会被线下真人pk！”
“你看我是那种不检点的人吗！”杨琪痛心疾首地说道，随即口风一转，“那个，有希这个妹子长得很漂亮？听你说的们好像很不一般！”
“有希在龙园的人气比孙雨还高，你说呢！？”林铮白着眼道。
“龙园？”杨琪愣了一下，“什么龙园啊？”
“擦！你真的是首都人吗！？”
“哦！哦！你说的是那个学校啊！”杨琪终于想起来了，在家里宅久了，好多东西都没什么印象了，“对了你刚刚说什么？人气比孙雨还高？怎么可能！？”
“信不信由你，总之你你别耍流氓就是了！就这样了！快点过来！”说罢，林铮又想起来还没有牧师，不得不问上一句，“对了，你有认识的奶妈吗？咱们这个队还缺个奶呢，A级的任务，没有一个强力点的奶妈团灭的几率可是不低！”

content_en:
"It belongs to the shopkeeper! This sword..." Lin Zheng just wanted to say, "I bought it!" But the fat shopkeeper spoke first. He said happily: "If the customer thinks this sword is expensive, it can actually be negotiated!"
"Oh?" Lin Zheng raised his eyebrows. Who would want to be ripped off if it was cheaper? "What should I say? How much discount can I get?"
"Haha! It's not about discounts!" The fat shopkeeper laughed, "I have something to do here, and it's been annoying me to death recently because I can't get around to do it. Guest, if you can help me solve it, I will give you this sword, and I will also give you a generous reward!"
"Damn it! That's right! This triggers the hidden mission!" The player next to him shouted in annoyance.
Lin Zheng glanced at it, ignored these troublesome guys, and said, "I wonder if I can help you?"
"That's what it looks like!" said the fat shopkeeper, "My naughty child broke the alchemy furnace in the Pharmacist Guild. Out of responsibility, I must find materials to repair the alchemy furnace. Now I need to find a heat-resistant metal mineral. I heard that there is a monster in the frost crystal cave that can produce this mineral in its body. Go and get this mineral for me!"
"You have accepted the mission 'The Trial of Extreme Cold'. The mission level is A-level. Go to the frost crystal cave in the north of Tianshuang City. Kill the boss at the bottom of the frost crystal cave to get the boss's core. The frost crystal cave is a dangerous place. It is best to find some companions before you go. The maximum number of people sharing the mission is 5!"
A-level team mission! The experience and rewards should be great! Of course, correspondingly, it will be very difficult! Moreover, the selection of personnel is also a big problem! First of all, Yang Qi can be counted as one, so who are the other three to look for? A wet nurse is a must, but the only wet nurse Lin Zheng knows is Xiaomiao, and she is also a good child who goes to bed immediately at 9:30, which is so unreliable! Forget it, let’s contact Yang Qi first to see if there is anything good to introduce.
"What's the matter, Xiao Linzi? Sister is busy. If you have anything to say, please tell me!" Yang Qi's voice reached Lin Zheng's ears. There were monsters roaring next to him. It was obvious that Yang Qi was busy killing monsters and leveling up. Lin Zheng didn't waste any time and said: "I took on a team task and it requires 5 people. You are one of them!"
"Team mission! What level is it?" Yang Qi asked with great interest.
"A-level medium, there must be enough oil and water!"
"Damn! Such an awesome task, wait for me! I'll be here right away!"
"Uh! There's no rush. It's a bit late. Let's go down and have a meal before we come back to cook!"
"That's right! It's already 7 o'clock!"
"I'll go down and boil water first, make some noodles and call you!"
"Go! Go!"
Lin Zheng got up from the game room and immediately went to boil water. Nowadays, all new energy sources are used, and heating technology has improved a lot. It only takes two or three minutes to boil water. In less than ten minutes, two large bowls of noodles were ready. Calling Yang Qi, the two of them finished the meeting in a few moments, and then hurriedly entered the game again. According to what Yang Qi said, mid-level A-level tasks cannot be completed in a few clicks, so you have to hurry up!
After getting into the game, Lin Zheng appeared at the door of the equipment store, and immediately lighted up. When he thought about the task, which required 5 people, in addition to finding a more reliable nanny, the other two, whoever was cheaper might as well give it to his own girl! So Lin Zheng sent an invitation to the two to form a team.
The system prompts: "The player's eldest son, Sun Youxi, has entered the team! The player's cute girl guardian has entered the team!"
"Let's all gather at the city gate and get ready to do the mission!" Lin Zheng shouted on the team channel.
"What's the mission, Brother Shengun!?" Xiaomeng asked.
"Come here and you'll find out!" "Beep!" A message came from Yang Qi's private chat. As soon as Lin Zheng answered the call, Yang Qi immediately shouted: "Two girls again, good boy. You have met four girls in one day. Are you playing games or picking up girls? Sister, I'm sad!"
"Go aside!" Lin Zheng said angrily, "Me andYou say it! When you meet them later, please be more honest, especially Yuxi. If you do anything inappropriate, I'm really worried that you will be PKed by a real person offline! "
“Do you think I’m the kind of disorderly person? Yang Qi said sadly, and then changed her tone, "Um, this girl Youxi is very beautiful?" From what you said, they seem very unusual! "
"Youxi is more popular than Sun Yu in Longyuan, what do you think? ? Lin Zheng rolled his eyes and said.
"Longyuan? Yang Qi was stunned for a moment, "What kind of dragon garden?" "
"wipe! Are you really from the capital! ? "
"oh! oh! That's the school you're talking about! "Yang Qi finally remembered. After staying at home for a long time, many things had no impression. "By the way, what did you just say? More popular than Sun Yu? How is that possible! ? "
"Believe it or not, just don't act like a hooligan! That’s it! Come quickly! After saying that, Lin Zheng remembered that there was no pastor yet, so he had to ask, "By the way, do you know any wet nurse?" Our team is still short of a nanny. For A-level missions, without a strong nanny, the chance of the team being wiped out is not low! "
